definitions.short: Joach , the name of four Israelites
definitions.full: H3098. Yoach יוֺאָח proper name, masculine ( ׳י is brother ; compare אֲחִיָּהוּ & references) — 1 son of Asaph the chronicler in Hezekiah's time 2Kin 18:18 , 26 , 37 ( ᵐ5 Ἰωας , ᵐ5 L Ἰωαχ ), = Isa 36:3 , 11 , 22 ( ᵐ5 Ἰωαχ ). 2 Levites a. son of Zimmah 1Chr 6:6 ; b. id. 2Chr 29:12 (twice in verse) ( ᵐ5 Ἰωα , Ἰωαχ ( α ), Ἰωδααθ ). 3 son of Joahaz the chronicles in Josiah's time 2Chr 34:8 ( ᵐ5 Ἰωαχ , Ἰωας ). 4 a Levite, son of Obed-edom 1Chr 26:4 ( ᵐ5 Ἰωαθ , Ἰωαα , Ἰωαδ ). יוֺאָחָז see יְהוֺאָחָז
